dimensions.note: No credential inputs or persisted command output; bounded failure excerpts redact common credential patterns.
Every method logs entry and successful completion without commands, paths, or output.
Validation, command, readiness, timeout, and certificate failures throw before resource persistence.
Synthetic tests cover success, malformed input, readiness failure, process cleanup, bounded output, and redaction without shared service startup.
Lifecycle commands are explicitly supervisor-owned and idempotent; postconditions are verified before one stable status write.
No external provider API; HTTP health checks are syntactically loopback-only, deadline-bounded, and retried.
Command duration and output are bounded; timeout terminates the process group and settles streams on error.
README contains only generic local examples and loopback addresses.
Global, nested, method, and output schemas are strict; authority is fixed to local-development.
The sole status resource declares infinite lifetime and bounded garbage collection.
The local process lifecycle is fully represented by start, stop, and status; this model does not own process creation.
Start and stop have a labeled policy check confining real working directories to the Swamp repository tree.
All methods intentionally write the same complete six-field StatusSchema to status-current; mechanical schema/write and field coverage checks pass.
Methods observe local process state and do not read persisted resources.
First registry publication; no prior model version exists to migrate.
